pages.text: Fluid Storage Disks are specialized storage devices designed for storing fluids in your Refined Storage network. These disks must be inserted into a $(l:disk_drive)Disk Drive$() to function. Like regular storage disks, they are non-volatile and won't despawn when dropped in the world.

Each disk can be uncrafted by shift + right-clicking with it in hand, returning:$(br)$(li)The corresponding Fluid Storage Part$(li)Storage Housing$(br2)Use these disks with a $(l:fluid_grid)Fluid Grid$() to view and manage stored fluids. Multiple disks can be combined in a single drive for expanded fluid storage capacity.
64k Fluid Storage Disk - Stores 64,000 mB of fluids
256k Fluid Storage Disk - Stores 256,000 mB of fluids
1024k Fluid Storage Disk - Stores 1,024,000 mB of fluids
4096k Fluid Storage Disk - Stores 4,096,000 mB of fluids
